_howto: THIS FILE IS THE INTEL STORE. Edit it, push, done — /billotech/intel/ rebuilds itself.
Add a product: copy a block, change the fields, set `live` to true.
Take one down: set `live` to false. Nothing else to touch.
`checkout` is a Square payment-link URL (square.link/u/XXXX). Leave it empty
and the card shows a 'reserve by email' state instead of a dead button — so a
half-wired product can never take someone's money and fail to deliver.
Square is the Billo OS rail (same as /billotech/pro/). Create a one-time
payment link per paid product in Square, paste its square.link URL here.

store.name: Location Intel
store.tagline: Forensic location analysis for your own data.

products.name: BSE Extract
products.blurb: One file. AirDrop it to a Mac, double-click, and it pulls your message history and a GPS track out of your own photos onto the Desktop.
highlights: Single self-contained file — no install, no dependencies, no repo
Reads the Messages database and photo EXIF, on your machine only
Handles the 2001 Apple epoch and the attributedBody blob that break naive exporters
Zero network calls — readable in any text editor before you run it
products.note: Needs Full Disk Access, which macOS prompts for. That prompt is the OS confirming a human consented — not a bug to route around.

products.name: Location Intel Toolkit
products.blurb: The engine. Every other location tool draws the dot; this one states the probability the dot is real, and flags when it isn't.
highlights: Containment: the probability the true position was inside a place, from the fix's accuracy radius
Verified against the Rayleigh closed form, the 68% platform convention, and Monte Carlo
Anchor/halo model that splits real destinations from the activity orbiting them
Flags mislocated anchors, gap-inflated dwell, duplicate timestamps, impossible speeds
Reads Google Takeout, Timeline JSON, iOS exports, GeoJSON and CSV
Runs entirely offline. Same input always gives the same result — no AI in the engine.
products.note: Includes BSE Extract and the full documented method.

products.name: Forensic Timeline Audit
products.blurb: Send your export. Get back a written audit of what the record actually supports — and what it does not.
highlights: Every visit scored: clean, suspect, or indeterminate
Mislabelled places identified and checked against public listings
Impossible transitions, drive-bys and parked-car 'driving' segments surfaced
Plain-English write-up of the limits of your own data
products.note: An audit of your own records. Not legal advice, and not an expert-witness engagement.

products.name: Commercial License
products.blurb: Use the engine inside client work, an internal tool, or a product you ship.
highlights: Deploy in commercial and client-facing work
Redistribute inside your own compiled product
products.note: The personal toolkit licence covers your own data only.
